name: Slider
description: A slider for a single value or a range, with a value bubble while dragging and optional tick marks.

props.name: label
props.description: Label above the track, on the left.

props.name: showValue
props.description: Show the formatted value above the track, on the right.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: Starting value when uncontrolled. Two numbers give a range with two thumbs.

props.name: onChange
props.description: Called continuously while the value changes.

props.name: onChangeEnd
props.description: Called when a drag or key press ends.

props.name: formatOptions
props.description: How values are written, e.g. { style: "unit", unit: "meter" } or { style: "currency", currency: "JPY" }.

props.name: marks
props.description: Values drawn as small ticks under the track.

props.name: size
props.description: Track of 4 or 6 pixels with a 16 or 18 pixel thumb.

props.name: thumbLabels
props.description: Accessible names for the two thumbs of a range.

props.name: isDisabled
props.description: Disables the slider and dims it to 50%.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every other prop of the react-aria-components Slider.
